scope: post-gate evidence integrity audit; no gates or benchmarks rerun

preflightInterpretation.meaning: Runner preflight recorded actual Node executable/hash, rustc/Cargo/pnpm/Deno versions and Darwin ARM64 identity, and enforced that Cargo output overrides were unset. The inherited broad cache inventory followed symlinks; it is not evidence of file deletion or source corruption. Its missing/different rows are interpreted against Git symlink mode and target bytes. For the separate 633 missing and 312 differing rows, the audit checks each path with lstat/readlink and compares symlink target bytes to HEAD blob metadata.
